description.en-US: The methods of mental prayer of the Catholic schools (Ignatian, Franciscan, Carmelite, Salesian, Liguorian, Oratorian, Eudist), with their difficulties and the direction of souls in prayer, gathered for Anglicans by a monk of the Anglican Benedictine community of Nashdom. Revised edition, 1935.
description.pt-BR: Os métodos de oração mental das escolas católicas (inaciana, franciscana, carmelita, salesiana, liguoriana, oratoriana, eudista), com as suas dificuldades e a direção das almas na oração, reunidos para anglicanos por um monge da comunidade beneditina anglicana de Nashdom. Edição revista, 1935.

sources.description: The Art of Mental Prayer, revised edition (London: Philip Allan, 1935), from a scan of the University of Chicago Library's copy. Text read from the scans with dots.mocr and proofread page by page by Claude against them (research/ocr-books).
